input_protocol.pooling: mean over unique source positions; repeated prefix/BOS/EOS averaged across windows

encoder_precision: FP32 weights/optimizer; BF16 CUDA autocast; FP32 head/pooling/loss
classifier_initialization: shared base RNG; LoRA initialization isolated; training RNG reset
initialization: fresh matching pretrained CodeBERT; identical seed42 linear head

augmentation.source_visibility: preserve the entire original visible character prefix under the native 2048 protocol
augmentation.pool: largest equal-visible-token-count bucket; ties prefer first proposal bucket; label/score independent
augmentation.selection: fixed two distinct views per function; random seed42 or shallow minimum/maximum; no label access
augmentation.loss: mean BCE over original plus two views, then mean over original functions; insufficient pools use original only

shallow.scoring: frozen fold model scores its heldout function only

robustness.selection: one eligible unseen view per kind, deterministic and independent of labels/model scores

selection: original Valid MCC threshold/epoch and tie-break
